news.contents: Bills quarterback Josh Allen is RotoBaller's No. 2-ranked quarterback as Buffalo takes on the aggressive Minnesota Vikings defense on Monday night. The Vikings are blitzing opposing quarterbacks at an incredibly high rate this season, with their blitz percentage sitting at 73.1%, according to Next Gen Stats. Expect Allen, who has been sacked just 13 times this season, to be under duress early and often against Minnesota. How he handles the blitz will be a deciding factor in Monday's contest. ...
news.title: Josh Allen Goes Up Against Vaunted Vikings Defense

news.analysis: Allen saw the return of Breece Hall to the lineup for the first time since Week 3. Allen has three 100 yard performances with Hall sidelined with a quad injury, but immediately saw his usage take a dip with Hall's return. Allen will likely remain the backup to Hall heading into a Week 10 matchup with Buffalo.
news.contents: Braelon Allen rushed for 33 yards on eight carries in the Jets' 35-12 loss to the Chiefs. He caught both of his targets for 21 yards.
news.title: Braelon Allen sees 10 touches in Week 9

news.contents: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen got eight carries with Breece Hall (quad) back in the lineup Sunday. Allen ran for 33 yards and caught both of his targets for 21 yards in the 35-12 Week 9 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. His 19-yard catch came on the opening drive, and he lost a yard on a carry from the Kansas City four-yard line later in that possession. Nick Bolton forced an Allen fumble in the second quarter, and the Chiefs scored two plays later. Allen finished with 5.4 PPR points ...
news.title: Braelon Allen's Flex Value Takes a Hit

news.analysis: Johnson was active but the Bears went with Salvon Ahmed for their backup RB touches instead of him. The team has yet to offer an explanation as to why this was the case vs. Tampa Bay. No longer worth rostering as a handcuff in fantasy, Johnson will head into his bye in Week 10.
news.contents: Roschon Johnson did not receive a touch in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.title: Roschon Johnson held without a carry in Week 9

news.analysis: McMillan caught a four-yard touchdown with just over three minutes remaining to pull Carolina within five points. He finished second on the Panthers in receiving yards behind Darren Waller, who saw 10 targets compared to McMillan's six. The touchdown helped, but Waller commanded more opportunities against Denver. McMillan remains a starting option in fantasy leagues heading into Week 10.
news.contents: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan scores touchdown in Week 9

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan continued to find success during Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos. The 23-year-old hauled in four of his six targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the loss. This was the first time that McMillan was able to find the end zone since the Week 4 matchup against the Detroit Lions. He has now finished with 50 receiving yards or more in four of his last five games. The hope is that his success will continue against the shaky New Orleans ...
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan Continues Consistent Play on Sunday

news.analysis: Boston had been quiet for the last several weeks, but got going again against the Saints. He's yet to rack up a 100-yard game, but he now has three games where he's accumulated at least 89 yards. He's more of a flex play right now, but he has the upside to be a WR2 on a given week.
news.contents: Denzel Boston caught six of seven targets for 98 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints in overtime on Sunday.
news.title: Denzel Boston goes for 98 yards in loss

news.contents: Cleveland Browns wide receiver Denzel Boston looks like a promising fantasy play in Week 9 at the New Orleans Saints. Boston will look to develop some chemistry with Shedeur Sanders, who is starting at quarterback over Deshaun Watson. Boston was targeted 12 times in the Week 8 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers and caught six passes for 37 receiving yards. The yards per catch were much lower than the norm for Boston who had established himself as a big-play wide receiver with Watson throwing him...
news.title: Denzel Boston A Good Play In Week 9 At New Orleans

news.title: NFL DFS Value Plays For Week 9: Devin Singletary, Jonah Coleman & More

news.analysis: Mayer nearly found the end zone, but he lost a fumble at the goal line. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.
news.contents: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.title: Michael Mayer hauls in three passes Sunday

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Michael Mayer continues to have some fantasy weight, but it will be limited against a stingy San Francisco 49ers defense in Week 9. Mayer has proven to be a flex option in the Brock Bowers-led offense, totaling 36 catches for 351 yards and one touchdown through eight games. He has also been very efficient, catching 84% of his targets this season. That includes five catches on six targets for 53 yards in a win against a solid New York Jets defense. That being said, ...
news.title: Michael Mayer a Streaming Option in Week 9 Matchup vs. 49ers

news.contents: Minnesota Vikings kicker Will Reichard is again a no-thought-required starting option when his team welcomes the Buffalo Bills on Monday Night Football. Despite the struggles of the Minnesota offense, their kicker has still performed, scoring double-digit fantasy points in four of the past five games. Behind backup quarterback Carson Wentz, the Vikings have to open up their offense to keep pace with Buffalo, but any improvement likely will mean more chances for Reichard. Additionally, the ...
news.title: High-Scoring Potential For Will Reichard In Week 9

news.analysis: Penix connected with Charlie Woerner on his lone touchdown pass of the day. This was a much better performance than his four interception clunker in Week 8. Penix and the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.
news.contents: Michael Penix Jr. completed 20-of-31 passes for 162 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals. He also added 50 rushing yards on three carries.
news.title: Michael Penix Jr. quiet in Week 9 loss

news.contents: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. completed 20 of his 31 pass attempts for 162 yards, one touchdown, and one interception during Sunday's Week 9 loss against the Cincinnati Bengals. He also ran for 50 yards on three rushing attempts. Penix's solid rushing output helped to make up for his low passing yard total, but overall, it was a relatively disappointing outing from the former first-round pick. This was definitely not the way Penix wanted to play in his first game back from a ...
news.title: Michael Penix Jr. Has a Quiet Day Passing in Week 9

news.analysis: Tucker did not get the ball as Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell led the Tampa backfield in the close loss. It is apparent that Tucker will need an injury ahead of him to carve out a role for the Bucs. He will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Lions.
news.contents: Sean Tucker did not receive any touches in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.title: Sean Tucker held without a touch in Week 9

news.analysis: Williams has struggled to make an impact in the Green Bay offense, logging less than 60 offensive yards in each of his four contests. the wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.contents: Savion Williams caught three of his four targets for 25 yards and one touchdown while also rushing three times for 13 yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.title: Savion Williams scores touchdown in Week 9 win

news.contents: Green Bay Packers wide receiver Savion Williams continues to see regular playing time, but his receiving opportunities remain limited heading into Week 9 against New England. Williams caught one of two targets for five yards against Carolina last week and added an 18-yard run. Since returning from injured reserve in Week 6, his targets have declined from four to three to two over three games. Williams has recorded eight receptions for 84 yards without a touchdown this season, despite playing ...
news.title: Savion Williams Has Limited Fantasy Appeal in Week 9 Against New England

news.contents: The Philadelphia Eagles continue to deal with injuries to key players in the wide receiver room, which opens the door for a more significant role for Hollywood Brown once again. The Eagles are preparing for a Week 9 matchup against the New York Giants, and it will be the third consecutive game in which Philadelphia will be without starters DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), This should lead to some targets for Brown against the Giants, although he has not been productive ...
news.title: Hollywood Brown Remains in Elevated Role for Eagles

news.analysis: Ferguson hauled in a 10-yard touchdown from Dak Prescott in the second quarter but later left with a knee injury during the third quarter. His status for Week 10's matchup vs. the 49ers is now in question. Brevyn Spann-Ford would be in line for a larger role if Ferguson can't suit up.
news.contents: Jake Ferguson caught both of his targets for 21 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.title: Jake Ferguson catches TD, leaves with knee injury in Week 9

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys tight end Jake Ferguson (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 9 game against the Indianapolis Colts, according to Joseph Hoyt, who reported that Ferguson was on the sideline with his helmet on. Ferguson had already returned from an earlier trip to the medical tent. He then took a hit to his left knee and immediately signaled for trainers, according to Nick Harris. Ferguson's lone first-half catch was a 10-yard touchdown from Dak Prescott on fourth-and-two. With Luke...
news.title: Jake Ferguson Questionable to Return Against Colts

news.analysis: Kirk becomes the latest San Francisco wide receiver to go down with an injury.
news.contents: The 49ers placed WR Christian Kirk on injured reserve.
news.title: Christian Kirk placed on IR

news.contents: The San Francisco 49ers have placed wide receiver Christian Kirk (knee) on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's Week 9 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders, according to Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports. He will now miss at least four games. Kirk's roster spot will go to wide receiver Demarcus Robinson, who was activated from IR on Saturday. The bad injury news continues for the Niners, who enter this week without receivers Mike Evans (Achilles), Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring), De'Zhaun Stribling ...
news.title: Christian Kirk Placed on Injured Reserve with Knee Injury

news.contents: The New York Giants' defense enters Week 9 as a top option against the injury-plagued Philadelphia Eagles. In their first seven games this season, the Giants D/ST have allowed 23.0 points per game (15th in the NFL) and 267 total yards per game (first in the NFL), and have recorded nine takeaways (16th in the NFL). Despite the massive losses of Brian Burns (ACL) and Tremaine Edmunds (shoulder), the defense has stayed afloat and helped the Giants lead the NFC East at 4-2-1. They face the Eagles, ...
news.title: New York Giants D/ST Looking to Take Advantage of Injury-Plagued Eagles

news.analysis: Taylor saw Kenyon Sadiq outpace him in targets, receiving yards, and receptions in the loss Sunday. Both Taylor and Sadiq continue to split time in the Jets' offense, capping both of their fantasy values.
news.contents: Mason Taylor caught 1-of-2 targets for 11 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.title: Mason Taylor hauls in one pass in Week 9 loss

news.contents: New York Jets tight end Mason Taylor (back) has drawn at least five targets in three straight games and could see more work Sunday at Kansas City with receiver Garrett Wilson (concussion) out. Taylor practiced fully on Thursday and Friday after being limited Wednesday and carries no game designation.
